# iru_blueprint_routing (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_blueprint_routing` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant's routing setting, with config for import.
list "iru_blueprint_routing" "this" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unused: every tenant has exactly one routing setting.
